body:
Really High
I was at my house all alone.  I was being really bored, and at first I only took 2 of the 10 mg methodones. After an hour or two I decided I wasnt felling high enough. I took two more 10's.
My cousin came over to help me work on my car that had broken down. I kept on asking him to smoke a bowl, but he said that I looked high enough.  I did not feel that high. Then it happened. The pills kicked in. I was really high now. We went to town and I started fealing a little nausiated and almost overwhelmed with the high I was experiencing. When I got home I ran to the bathroom and vomited.  The rest of the night I laid in my bed and felt sick and really high.  The next morning when I woke up I was still high until late that after noon.
